desc: The Prescott project "Rogue" was POF-USA' s exercise to turn the Revolution platform into the lightest semi auto rifle on the market, and to do it without needless "lightening" cuts. All while delivering a rifle at a price point affordable to serious shooters. Built on the Rogue platform, the Prescott makes hunting with a semi-auto reality. Don't go mobile with an overweight rifle. At 7 pounds, the 6.5 Creedmoor Prescott is built to hunt, and go everywhere you do.
